context: M20 o3. Lisle's conference room. Augie, Villalba, Wurtz in a borrowed suit, Nick. Lisle at the head.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Gentlemen. Our arrangement is simple. Nobody touches cash. Everything is a fee.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: Surcharge comes in, your cut goes out. Same as always. What's new?

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: What's new is that it's legal. Nicholas's name is on every hotel. Very clean.

lines.speaker: char.dennis_wurtz
lines.text: Knapp was weather. Weather passes. Paperwork's climate. Right, counselor?

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Notwithstanding the lieutenant's metaphors. Yes. Every hotel.
